Fine particles (PM2.5) can reach deep into the lungs. At this current reading, consider reducing prolonged outdoor exertion, especially with asthma, heart or lung disease. A well-fitting N95/FFP2 respirator can help if you must be outdoors.

Fine particles (PM2.5) are high in this current reading. Avoid prolonged outdoor exertion and keep windows closed where possible. Sensitive groups should stay indoors; use a well-fitting N95/FFP2 respirator if going outside is unavoidable.
